objective: Add a digest-bound, route-only verification sidecar after immutable workflow instantiation that maximizes deterministic and symbolic controls while preserving bounded exploratory reasoning.

todos.action: Define versioned overlay, atom, authority, uncertainty, obligation, grounding-matrix, assessment, and proposed-repair schemas.
acceptance: all schemas reject unknown critical fields
every claim and derivation has stable plan provenance
verification_ready is distinct from evidence_validated

todos.action: Implement a pure build_post_plan_verification function after immutable workflow instantiation.
acceptance: canonical initial-plan digest is unchanged
no store, network, filesystem, execution, installation, or route mutation occurs
disabled mode preserves the existing planner result

todos.action: Compile material outputs into typed ClaimAtoms with requirement, consumer, node, source-turn, and terminal-artifact traceability.
acceptance: facts, derivations, hypotheses, user constraints, future actions, execution states, and unknowns remain distinct
incidental prose does not become a material claim

todos.action: Assign deterministic, symbolic, statistical, generative, or human verification using the least-flexible adequate method.
acceptance: exact-oracle cases never require a generative judge
every flexible-method assignment records why stricter methods are inadequate
no silent provider substitution

todos.action: Compile claim-relative inclusion, exclusion, role, directness, currency, authority, conflict-search, and stop policies before retrieval.
acceptance: authority is assertion-specific rather than globally ranked
source snapshot and policy digests are frozen
abstract-only and metadata-only ceilings are explicit

todos.action: Implement exact locator validation, derivation closure, grounding matrix construction, and claim-ceiling propagation.
acceptance: no material released claim is orphaned
contradictions remain represented
every promotion beyond evidence directness is rejected

todos.action: Emit local dispositions and JSON-Patch-like proposed repairs without mutating the initial plan.
acceptance: unrelated verified nodes survive a local failure
route-critical failures are explicit
repairs require the existing versioned refinement lifecycle

todos.action: Map semantic obligations to existing evidence, provenance, fidelity, directness, sufficiency, formal-grounding, and claim-ceiling skills.
acceptance: existing skills are composed rather than duplicated
the deterministic kernel remains runtime code
unavailable instruction-only skills cannot advertise execution

todos.action: Define immutable verification_context ports for already-produced external-source, framework, and package-search planning receipts.
acceptance: receipt digests are bound into the overlay
no network or retrieval is moved into verification
standalone wheel has no host catalog import

todos.action: Implement schema, registry, hash, version, identity, join, unit, arithmetic, set, DAG, artifact, extraction, and evidence-completeness checks.
acceptance: deterministic cases are repeatable and order invariant
failures identify exact claim/node/field
no semantic score overrides an exact failure

todos.action: Add environment/provider preflight, input/output digests, estimand, parameters, seed, tolerance, replication, and fixtures.
acceptance: provider unavailable is typed
seeded and stochastic methods remain distinguishable
reproducibility is not promoted to empirical truth

todos.action: Cluster source independence and retain contradictions so mirrored records cannot masquerade as corroboration.
acceptance: duplicate sources contribute one independence cluster
high-authority conflict remains visible
source count never resolves truth automatically

todos.action: Add an allowed-evidence envelope for paraphrase, synthesis, rival explanations, and hypotheses plus independent claim-fidelity review.
acceptance: new factual specifics outside allowed evidence IDs are rejected
candidate extraction requires exact-anchor verification
the producer is not the sole evaluator of a material output

todos.action: Implement risk-proportional exploratory/confirmatory templates, anti-paranoia exemptions, bounded search, and local failure propagation.
acceptance: approved hypotheses survive as proposed
user constraints, future actions, deterministic derivations, placeholders, and unknowns are not falsely blocked
claim strength and impact drive severity

todos.action: Invalidate only dependent assessments when the plan, requirement, source release/content, method/version, parameter, authority, or source policy changes.
acceptance: unchanged findings retain digests
changed dependencies cannot reuse stale passes
invalidation is transitive and local

todos.action: Add user-facing verification summaries and normalized reasoning-log events.
acceptance: summary reports what was checked and remaining uncertainty
no hidden chain-of-thought is exposed
verification readiness is not described as executed evidence

todos.action: Make refinement and release consume overlay findings/test specifications without granting the overlay new planning authority.
acceptance: blocking findings enter existing gates
advisories do not globally block exploration
the initial plan remains immutable

todos.action: Add ontology, namespace, temporal, protocol, scope, premise, and claim-ceiling constraint contracts.
acceptance: results are entailed, contradicted, or unknown
unsat cores or counterexamples are returned
formal conclusions remain bounded to premises

todos.action: Build 24 paired disclosed post-plan grounding cases, mutation probes, and a separately governed sealed corpus.
acceptance: cases cover exact extraction, authority, symbolic constraints, exploration, claims, unknowns, prompt injection, and non-interference
oracles are versioned and withheld where required

todos.action: Prove non-interference when verification is disabled, passed, caveated, repair-required, or locally blocked.
acceptance: base plan bytes/canonical digest remain identical
only additive sidecar and proposed repair surfaces differ
repeated receipts are deterministic

todos.action: Test fabricated citations, source swaps, unit/value mismatch, access-level confusion, duplicate corroboration, prompt injection, overpromotion, stale authority, denied sources, and execution-state hallucination.
acceptance: zero fabricated specifics escape
prompt injection is inert
mutations change only logically affected findings

todos.action: Test benign user constraints, prospective actions, hypotheses, deterministic transformations, generic methods, placeholders, and unknowns.
acceptance: zero blocking false positives on explicit benign controls
broader benign specificity is at least 0.95
only unsupported factual promotion is blocked

todos.action: Report grounding, anchor fidelity, unsupported escape, claim-ceiling, routing, conflict, repair-locality, false-positive, latency, and cost metrics.
acceptance: deterministic and semantic metrics are separate
family-level strict pass is reported
lexical checks are not presented as semantic certification

todos.action: Update packaged schemas, persistent-change profiles, hook invariants, README, lifecycle docs, standalone verifier, capability maps, and release checks.
acceptance: new/extend/refine profiles include the post-plan stage
direct-use/control routes remain not applicable
standalone wheel and route-only boundaries pass
